Results.ReviewText:
I love my Weber charcoal grills, I had my last classic black 22" charcoal grill for 15+ years before relocating which was still great just replacing the grilling grates when needed. Used it year round in the NY area in sun, rain, snow, sleet weather. I would catch my neighbors peeking out their windows when I would grill particularly in the winter when the rough cold and snow would keep them inside but yes, I would be grilling!
So after moving I retired the ol' faithful "Man-a-Q" and decided it was time for a new one. Super happy when I came across the Master-Touch 22" in Ocean Blue by chance and picked it up. (the color sold me on the spot, more of a brighter blue and not dark blue) It is packaged with some nice accessories like the 2 charcoal basket holders for indirect cooking & the warming rack that circles half the outer circumference of the grill. Not to mention a new lid holder design that is superior to the old hanger on my previous Weber. Very nice options! Overall a true Weber classic charcoal grill with some modern great updates.
So why not 5 stars? I used my new Weber the day I brought it home (of course) to cook up some dinner. I went out after to clean everything up to notice a roughly 3" circle piece of the paint missing from the lid! (I made sure to inspect the grill previous since it came preassembled) Super disappointing since it sticks out like a sore thumb with the blue color, I take care of my grill so the only thing it could be is some kind of defect in the paint / color. Contacted Weber support the next day via website chat (provided pics, ect) and the Weber support agent was quick to back their product and put a order in for a new replacement lid on the spot! Only downside is its on backorder since the new color is in high demand but its only a aesthetic issue that irks me looking at it.

I've only owned charcoal grills and after a few different brands Weber has been the brand in my back yard or where ever I go. Some like propane which is a "instant-on" convenient grill but I find it the same as cooking in the oven, pellet is awesome but in inclement weather like rain you would not catch me plugging a grill in to an outlet. Weber Charcoal grills have always been the ol' reliable for year round grillin and look forward to using my new Weber for years!
Results.Title: Classic Weber charcoal grill with great updates

Results.ReviewText: Going on 3 years with my Master-Touch. I have a gas grill, offset smoker and pellet grill and if I don't need the size of the offset or pellet I will ALWAYS use my kettle. Results.ReviewText:
Weber manufactures a superior product, hands down.  I’ve owned several Webers over the past 35 years.  This latest model is, by far, the most advanced with great features such as the built in thermometer in the lid, the tool holders on the handle, and the easy and convenient ash collector system.  

With the durability of Weber products I’m certain that this grill will perform perfectly for years to come.

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
